meta.name: infinitetalk
meta.description: 音频驱动的稀疏帧视频配音工具，支持音频驱动的 Video-to-Video 和 Image-to-Video 生成，实现精准的唇形、头部、身体姿态同步，支持无限时长视频生成

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用音频驱动生成同步唇形和姿态的视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为视频或图片人物精准匹配音频口型和动作
copy.tagline_en: Generate lip-synced videos driven by audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to match audio with precise lip and body movements in videos

howto.what: 装上后，你给一张人像图片或一段视频加一段音频，它就生成口型、头部和身体动作与语音同步的说话视频；也支持对长音频分段流式生成不限时长视频，并可用文本来合成驱动音频。
howto.when: 当需要生成音频驱动的数字人视频、视频配音或虚拟主播内容时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片和这段录音，生成一段说话视频。
say.note: 会以图片为起点生成音频驱动的视频。

say.text: 把这个视频重新配音成这段音频的内容。
say.note: 会对已有视频做重配音，口型与头部动作跟随新音频。

say.text: 把这句话转成语音并生成配套说话视频：今天天气不错。
say.note: 会先用文本转语音合成音频，再生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, you provide a portrait image or a video plus an audio clip, and it produces a talking video with lip, head, and body motion synced to the speech. It can also stream long audio into unlimited-length video, and can synthesize driving audio from text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs an audio-driven digital human video, video re-dubbing, or virtual anchor content.

say_en.text: Use this photo and this audio clip to generate a talking video.
say_en.note: Creates an audio-driven video from the image.

say_en.text: Re-dub this video with this new audio track.
say_en.note: Lip and head motion follow the new audio.

say_en.text: Turn this sentence into speech and generate a matching talking video: The weather is nice today.
say_en.note: Uses TTS first, then generates the video.
